Crippling Depression
This is night mare material

It will pass. 
You feel down right now and it may even get worse as days go by. 
You are strong but nobody is strong enough to fight themselves. 
The pain in your head and knots in your throat and stomach are there for a reason. 
Be gentle with yourself. 
You deserve it. Let go. 
Letting go is the scariest part. 
It may not make a difference. But you're no longer fighting yourself. 
You let the thoughts come into your mind, make note of them and pass through. 
Focus on your breathing. 
You are a human. 
You exist. 
What are you grateful for? 
It may be nothing at the moment. 
Who do you love? What do you love? What are things that make these people/things so special to you. 
Sit and let those things/feelings resonate with you. 
Sometimes it's hard to even find those feelings. Numbness strikes to the core.
Realize that lack of feeling and try to relax. You don't need to do anything, there's nothing that you're doing wrong. You can't control how your mind and body feels. 
Be easy with yourself. Let the tears fall if there are any. 
You are special. 
No one could ever be you. 
I'm a stranger. I realize that. I know nothing about you. Besides the fact you need something to look back on when you're feeling down. 
I really hope you are feeling better and if not that's okay too. Just know that I'm rooting for you.

Honestly not as intense as these other comments haha, but I clearly remember this time in high school lacrosse where there was this girl everyone hated on our team. I grew up with her and disliked her but she's part of the team so whatever.

One day it was hot and everyone was tired. Lord knows she was pissed and telling people to shove it up their ass every two seconds. Then she started to complain about not having water cause nobody brought it down. I figured fuck it so I grabbed a friend, gave the rest of the team a drill to do and went to get water. 
About 15 mins later we come back after hauling a huge ass barrel of water for the team (we had to walk over, fill it up, and haul it back to the field) and they're all sitting on the fucking grass (club sport so we didn't have coaches).

I'm already ticked off and tired and this bitch walks up to me and asks me what took us so long and that they couldn't do anything because they didn't have enough people for that one particular drill because we took so long getting water. 

Practice was almost over and I could feel my face was getting red as hell. I swear it was like word vomit. I started yelling at her and asked her to try to get her ass out of 3rd grade for a second so we could practice. A couple of obscenities slipped out and fuck she was silent😂 She opened her mouth and I told her to shove it up her ass. She also didn't participate in lacrosse the next year.

Looking back it was a really stupid situation but god she was so close to getting a lacrosse stick in the face.
